question: At the qualified R22 exhaustive sixteen-context state, are the 35 balanced partitions that fail every phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate projection exactly the partitions that preserve all eight antipodal pairs, while every mixed pair-relation partition and every fully separating partition reproduces full-five-coordinate membership in all four panels?
hypothesis: The R22 residual is an exact antipodal-pair-relation trichotomy: all 128 partitions separating every antipodal pair and all 6272 partitions with a mixture of separated and preserved antipodal pairs match all four panels, while exactly the 35 complement-normalized balanced partitions preserving every antipodal pair match zero panels; no partition is partial.

prior_evidence.observation: On the exact exhaustive sixteen-context state, all 128 fully separating partitions and 6272 of 6307 nonseparating partitions matched all four panels; exactly 35 nonseparating partitions matched zero and none matched partially. Thirty-five equals the independently derivable count C(8,4)/2 of complement-normalized balanced partitions that preserve every antipodal pair.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one R22 dimension: partitions are stratified by the complete antipodal-pair relation (fully separating, mixed, or fully preserving) instead of the binary fully-separating predicate. Records, exhaustive contexts, partition enumeration, four projections, exact membership comparison, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.r22_replication_control: Run the unchanged local deterministic R22 probe and require its frozen exhaustive classification and exact 128/6272/35 match cardinalities before R23 output.
arms_and_inputs.exhaustive_state: For each of nine entities and three surface families, include every context_index 0..15 exactly once, yielding 432 records and sixteen records per surface.
arms_and_inputs.partition_enumeration: Enumerate masks 0..65535 ascending; retain exactly popcount-eight masks with bit zero clear, yielding 6435 complement-normalized balanced partitions.
arms_and_inputs.pair_relation: For each q in 0..7 compare bit(q) with bit(q+8). A partition is fully_separating when all eight differ, fully_preserving when all eight agree, and mixed otherwise.
arms_and_inputs.combinatorial_cardinalities: Require exactly 128 fully_separating, 35 fully_preserving, and 6272 mixed partitions. Independently enumerate all choose-four subsets of the eight antipodal pairs, construct pair-union masks, complement-normalize them, and require their distinct set to equal the 35 fully_preserving masks.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: For every retained mask evaluate [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], and [bucket,suffix1] against full-five-coordinate membership, exactly 25740 arms in mask then coordinate order.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.exhaustive_arm: none; every latent context is enumerated exactly once
seeds.r22_control: Exact frozen R22 construction and its inherited R21 seeds.

controls: The unchanged local deterministic R22 probe must reproduce exhaustive_antipodal_separation_sufficient_not_necessary, 128 separating all-four matches, 6272 nonseparating all-four matches, 35 nonseparating zero matches, no partial match, zero false negatives, and 6272 false positives before R23 output.
The exhaustive full-five-coordinate control must reproduce 432 records, nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
Enumeration must yield exactly 6435 distinct balanced complement-normalized masks partitioned exclusively into 128 fully separating, 6272 mixed, and 35 fully preserving masks.
An independent choose-four antipodal-pair construction must yield exactly the same 35 fully preserving masks.
All 25740 arms run once in ascending mask then derived-coordinate order; entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R22 probe reproduces its frozen classification and exact cardinalities before R23 output.
Each surface contains every context index 0..15 exactly once.
Pair-relation classes are exhaustive, mutually exclusive, formula-checked, and have the frozen cardinalities; the fully preserving set equals the independent construction.
Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.antipodal_pair_relation_trichotomy_exact: Validity and controls pass; all 128 fully separating and all 6272 mixed partitions match all four panels, all 35 fully preserving partitions match zero panels, no partition is partial, and classification mismatch count is zero.
classification_rules.fully_preserving_not_necessary_for_failu: Validity and controls pass; at least one fully separating or mixed partition fails one or more panels.
classification_rules.fully_preserving_not_sufficient_for_fail: Validity and controls pass; at least one fully preserving partition matches one or more panels.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R22, exhaustive-state, full-five-coordinate, enumeration, cardinality, normalization, uniqueness, or independent-set control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed 25740-arm panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, class-exclusivity, arm-cardinality, projection, context-completeness, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.
